records.name: RetainIQ
records.tagline: Know which customers need attention, why & what to do next
records.description: RetainIQ shows B2B SaaS teams which customers need attention, why, and what to do next, ranked by revenue at risk. Every recommendation comes with the evidence behind it, so your team can act with confidence. Recover prioritizes failed payments. Retain shows churn evidence and confidence. Reactivate finds dormant customers worth contacting. Start free for 15 days, no credit card.

records.name: Cognition SWE-2.1
records.tagline: A long-horizon coding model with a 10x faster Ultrafast mode
records.description: SWE-2.1 is Cognition's upgraded coding model, trained with pure reinforcement learning on Kimi K3 for long-horizon work. Per Cognition, FrontierCode 2.0 rose from 24.1 to 41.3, Terminal-Bench 4.1 from 24.2 to 50.0 and ExploitBench from 36.1 to 80.0. SWE-2.1 Ultrafast runs about 10x faster with Cerebras. Available in Devin Desktop, Cloud and CLI, free through December 8 on Desktop and CLI.

records.name: Superrelay
records.tagline: One inbox for every app you ship, never priced per ticket
records.description: One support workspace for teams shipping several apps: chat, email, WhatsApp, Slack and in-app in one inbox. An AI agent that cites sources and asks before acting, GitHub-synced docs, and a CLI/MCP so coding agents read tickets. Never priced per ticket.

records.name: RankTheSearch
records.tagline: Make the TikTok posts your buyers are already searching for
records.description: Nearly half of US consumers now use TikTok as a search engine (Adobe, 2026). Paste your product link and RankTheSearch finds the searches where today's answers are weak, rates each one from 0 to 100, then makes the slideshows and videos that answer them.

records.name: Tano
records.tagline: Korean vocabulary app that skips the words you know
records.description: Tano is an iPhone app for learning Korean vocabulary. A short level check skips the words you already know. Then you get a few new words a day, each with an example sentence and sound, and reviews tomorrow, in 3 days and in a week. Words come sorted into 20 real-life situations and 53 topics. Practice by choosing the meaning, filling in the sentence or writing in Hangul, while your avatar grows from 아기 to 어른. Free to start, no account needed.

records.name: Microsoft-Decision-1.1
records.tagline: Microsoft's decision model: calibrated, 2x faster, now GA
records.description: Microsoft-Decision-1.1 is a decision model, trained to make reliable choices inside software instead of writing text. It picks from permitted actions, reports confidence so apps can defer when unsure, and now accepts images. Per Microsoft, it is over 2x faster than v1 at about the same cost, and scores 68 on the Artificial Analysis Decision Index. Generally available on Microsoft Foundry, OpenRouter and Vercel after a public preview last month.

records.name: GrayPass
records.tagline: Verify who’s in control before agents make sensitive actions
records.description: Login tools tell you who signed in. GrayPass verifies who’s still in control when it actually matters. Before a wire, payout change, admin grant, or other sensitive action executes, GrayPass uses behavioral and session evidence to decide whether to allow, re-verify, hold, or deny it. Its Brainprint learns how each person types, moves, and scrolls without capturing what they type, adding fresh assurance without forcing MFA on every user.

records.name: DearDarling
records.tagline: A couples messenger with a mutual friend, Pip
records.description: One of the attractions at DearMate, a virtual AI theme park. A private messenger for two, with Pip: a mutual friend who knows your chat, gives one tip when you ask, and talks to each of you alone without taking sides. Every night, your day becomes a page.

records.name: airoom
records.tagline: An open-source control room for your Claude Code agents
records.description: Every project is a room and every Claude Code session is a desk. See who is working, who is waiting on you and who is stuck. Chat, approve commands, hire a team, or let an agent test your app in the built-in browser. Free, local and open source.

records.name: gutcheck
records.tagline: Check your gut against the internet, inside Claude Code
records.description: Before you build it, find out if anyone wants it. Type /gutcheck and an idea, a problem or a decision in Claude Code. It plans a study, pulls live evidence from Google Trends, Google News, Hacker News, GitHub, the App Store, Wikipedia and the web, and gives you a verdict: how sure it is, the case against, and what to do this week. No API keys to start. Runs on your machine. Free and open source.

records.name: overads.io
records.tagline: Marketing and GTM that run while you sleep
records.description: overads runs marketing and GTM for founders, end to end. Describe a job once and it becomes a workflow that runs every week. It writes, designs and schedules posts for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X and Pinterest. It watches your Meta and Google ads, and you can pause a campaign or move a budget right from chat. GTMgenie runs your outbound on email and LinkedIn. Nothing goes out without your yes. One plan, $59/month.

records.name: NOVA
records.tagline: Development to deployment, and everything after.
records.description: Building is the easy part. NOVA handles what comes after: hosting, your own domain, search and AI-search readiness, version history, team editing, and a one-command handover to a developer's terminal. One account, one plan, from development to deployment.

records.name: Slopie
records.tagline: A free 3D map of every ski resort, in your browser
records.description: Slopie shows more than 4,000 ski resorts in 69 countries in 3D, with every run and lift on the real terrain. The whole map is free in any browser, with no account. The iPhone and Apple Watch app records your ski days on the same map.

records.name: Dex Telemetry
records.tagline: Open-source Datadog for analytics
records.description: You set up analytics to monitor your business. But who's monitoring your analytics? Dex Telemetry gives you observability for your pipelines, with rules and context built for your agents.

records.name: Bento
records.tagline: Runnable lessons and interactive maps of GitHub repos
records.description: Bento is a free, open-source Mac app for learning how software works. Get runnable lessons from questions or take apart GitHub repos. It uses the AI subscription you already have. Try ready-made lessons and featured repos in your browser, no install.

records.name: ro
records.tagline: I won't bother you
records.description: ro sits quietly on your Mac desktop or menu bar and stays out of your way. Free as a desktop pet that reacts to your apps. Unlock Pro for local file search (⌥R), Downloads cleanup with undo, and private AI handoff. Nothing leaves your Mac.

records.name: Tallhorn
records.tagline: A native MongoDB® client where AI agents ask before writing
records.description: Tallhorn is a fast, native MongoDB® client for Mac, built with SwiftUI and AppKit. Browse documents as a table, tree or JSON, script queries in JavaScript, build pipelines stage by stage, read explain plans, and turn queries into dashboards. A built-in MCP server lets Claude Code, Cursor and VS Code query your databases under rules you set per connection, and by default every agent write waits for your approval. No account, no analytics. Free; Pro adds dashboards and agents, $29.99 once.

records.name: Wender Desktop
records.tagline: A 100% free Paper alternative
records.description: Wender Desktop is a 100% free HTML canvas design tool for Mac. Use your own agent subscriptions, own your files forever and self host on a free Cloudflare plan for sharing and collaboration, and work with your real code and components. No MCP limits. No seat limits.

records.name: Stacktrace
records.tagline: Real-time steering and guardrails for AI agents
records.description: Stacktrace is a control layer for AI agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Devin. It reads their tool calls, blocks unsafe ones before they run, enforces the limits your team sets and steps in when an agent drifts from its intent.

records.name: OpenCrawl
records.tagline: Multiplayer for your coding agents
records.description: OpenCrawl lets your coding agents search each other's histories and talk to each other, across laptops and cloud coding environments. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and more. Open source, self-hostable and free to start.

records.name: Supabase RLS Leak Check
records.tagline: See which Supabase tables strangers can read, in 20 seconds
records.description: Apps built with Lovable, Bolt and v0 ship your Supabase URL and anon key to every visitor. That's by design. What matters is whether Row Level Security actually stops those visitors from reading your data. Paste your project URL and anon key and it tries to read each table as a stranger. Runs entirely in your browser, shows row counts only (never contents), refuses secret keys, no signup.

records.name: AION Analytics (India)
records.tagline: Veritas: Pre-Market Range and Directional Lean
records.description: Pre-open ranges and directional lean for Indian indices, with a live rolling 30-session scorecard and a permanent historical validation archive.

records.name: AI Answer Check - $99
records.tagline: AI Answer Check
records.description: AI Answer Check - $99

records.name: AI Clothes Changer
records.tagline: Turn flat lay product photos into on-model images
records.description: Show every piece in your shop on a model without a shoot. Upload a flat lay or hanger photo plus a model photo and get a 2K on-model image in about a minute, with the same face, pose and backdrop.

records.name: Short dramas world
records.tagline: Trending & New Short Dramas | V123 Drama
records.description: Discover Short Dramas: Trending & New Short Dramas | V123 Drama. Browse trending short drama series and new releases at https://v123drama.com

records.name: Amorphite
records.tagline: Be Thoughtful , Be Amorphite
records.description: Free audio BPM & key finder, delay ms calculator, metronome, chromatic tuner, LUFS & royalty estimator + 14 Studio Tools

records.name: the $2,200 Amazon Gift Card Giveaway
records.tagline: Discover the $2,200 Amazon Gift Card Giveaway
records.description: Find the details for this $2,200 Amazon gift card giveaway, including how to enter and whether your location is eligible. Read all rules carefully before submitting an entry. This promotion is not administered by Amazon.

records.name: DriveProtocol
records.tagline: Car reviews, buying guides & free tools
records.description: DriveProtocol is a free guide to buying and owning a car the smart way: 40 original articles — honest car reviews, buying guides, EVs, SUVs, maintenance, insurance and financing, plus a look at the most anticipated 2027 cars — and 5 free tools (Auto Loan, Fuel Cost, Affordability,Depreciation and MPG Calculator). Every guide is written for real buyers, and everything is free with no sign-up.

records.name: FlowFi
records.tagline: Solana token scanner with a safety check and public results
records.description: FlowFi watches every new Solana token, runs a safety check as it launches, and shows the few drawing real money and real people. Every call is graded in public, misses included. Free on web and iPhone, with a trading competition live today.

records.name: The Freeing Method Studio
records.tagline: Your talking clip, cleaned up and captioned on your computer
records.description: Captioned vertical videos and carousels on your computer. Helps clean up pauses, ums, and repeated lines after you see the plan. Your clips stay on your computer. It never posts for you. Editing works without an AI. Ask AI uses ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, or Muse.

records.name: موالي
records.tagline: تطبيق يخص الأدعية والزيارات
records.description: موالي | رفيقك في طريق الإيمان موالي هو تطبيق ديني يجمع بين روح الإيمان والتصميم العصري، ليكون رفيقك في رحلتك الروحية، ويقرّبك من أجواء أهل البيت عليهم السلام. واجهة بسيطة، تجربة مميزة، ومحتوى يلامس القلب ويمنح يومك طابعاً إيمانياً خاصاً. موالي… لأن الولاء عقيدة، والإيمان حياة.

records.name: Spot the AI Attack
records.tagline: A 2-minute game: find the line that hijacks your AI
records.description: Your AI assistant reads emails, calendars, code and web pages, and attackers hide instructions in them. Spot the AI Attack shows you 10 things an AI agent is about to read. Tap the line that hijacks it. Every round is based on a real, published attack, like the Rules File Backdoor and a calendar invite that made Gemini control a smart home. Free, no sign-up, runs in your browser.

records.name: The Kelly Table
records.tagline: A free 3D game that teaches the Kelly criterion
records.description: The Kelly Table is a free 3D coin-flip strategy game that teaches the Kelly criterion. You start with a $100 virtual bankroll (no real money). Tables: Classic 60% (Full Kelly 20%, Half Kelly 10%), Headwind 45%, Even 50%, Tailwind 70%, and Wall St. Market (20 rounds, hidden regimes, two tactical cards). The Global Daily uses the same 50-flip seed for everyone, resets at 00:00 UTC, and has a server-verified leaderboard. Free Practice needs no account. Optional cosmetics do not change the odds.

records.name: ScreenMouse
records.tagline: Low-latency keyboard and mouse sharing for Win, Mac, Linux
records.description: Use one keyboard and mouse across several computers. Push the cursor past the edge of one screen and it continues on the next computer, with copy-paste and file drag-and-drop between them. Built for speed: each mouse movement is an 11-byte message, and the added delay is well under 1 ms on a wired network. Works between Windows, macOS and Linux, pairs with a one-time 4-digit code, and encrypts traffic with TLS 1.3. Free for the first month (up to 2 months).

records.name: Quotex Clone Script
records.tagline: Build Trading Platforms With Fast Execution and Live Charts
records.description: Digital options trading is creating new opportunities for businesses exploring online trading markets. A Quotex Clone Script provides a foundation for building a platform based on the Quotex trading model. From market price tracking to trade placement and expiry management, create a branded trading environment that reflects your business goals. Have a trading platform idea in mind? Let's explore what's possible!

records.name: GenCrow
records.tagline: AI sorts all your Gmail inboxes and flags what needs you
records.description: Connect all your Gmail accounts once. GenCrow reads each new email, sorts it into Action, Task, Review or Noise, finds who needs what by when, and ranks it 0–100. What needs you lands in one Attention Center; urgent items reach you on WhatsApp. Read-only, bodies never stored.

records.name: Onchain Terminal
records.tagline: Market intelligence terminal for crypto traders
records.description: Onchain Terminal is a market intelligence terminal for active crypto traders. Follow Hyperliquid whale trades and positions live, see where liquidations cluster across exchanges, and browse 377 on-chain, cycle and derivatives charts. Build your own dashboard, then set multi-condition alerts that reach you on Telegram, email or in the browser. Includes an AI analyst and a paper-trading simulator on live prices. Free plan available.

records.name: Drive GPS
records.tagline: GPS navigation app that rewards you with free fuel
records.description: Free GPS navigation with voice guidance, live traffic and speed camera alerts that rewards every trip and every step. Miles turn into free fuel at major brands in 57 countries, coupons and prizes. Multi-stop delivery routes and walk to earn.

records.name: Merget
records.tagline: A GitHub merge queue for parallel AI coding agents
records.description: Merget uses static analysis to check how open pull requests affect one another. It can flag conflicts and order changes across multiple agents or developers working in the same GitHub repository. Teams can start in Advisory mode to review what Merget finds before enabling automatic actions.

records.name: YKS Yolculuğum
records.tagline: TYT AYT Plan, Pomodoro, Deneme
records.description: YKS Yolculuğum, TYT ve AYT'ye hazırlanırken her gün ne çalışacağını bilmeni sağlar. YKS Pro ile (tek seferlik satın alma, abonelik yok): 5 renk teması, fotoğraflı Yanlış Defteri, paylaşılabilir Haftalık Rapor, deneme gelişim ve analiz grafikleri. Çalışma verilerin telefonunda kalır, hesap açman gerekmez. Ücretsiz sürümde Google AdMob ile küçük, kişiselleştirilmemiş banner reklam gösterilir; YKS Pro'da reklam yoktur. Bu uygulama ÖSYM ile bağlantılı değildir; puanlar resmî YKS puanı değildir.

records.name: Aivora
records.tagline: AI agents and RPA that automate approved business workflows
records.description: Aivora offloads repetitive digital work to AI-powered digital workers. It combines AI agents, RPA, browser automation, document AI and APIs, with human approval, role-based access and audit logs, to run authorized workflows across web apps and documents.

records.name: Antigravity Reset
records.tagline: Live Google Antigravity quota reset tracker, API & MCP
records.description: Track Google Antigravity quota resets from @_mohansolo in real time so you never miss a reset across Gemini, Argon, Carbon, Hydrogen, or all models. Features a 28-week reset heatmap, average interval stats, Mohan time vs. local time switcher, and 5 languages (EN, ZH-CN, ZH-TW, JA, KO). Built for developers and AI agents with a free no-key JSON API, RSS 2.0 and Markdown feeds, a portable Agent Skill, and a zero-auth remote MCP server. 100% free and open source.

records.name: ClipTap
records.tagline: Insert saved replies and AI prompts on your phone or Mac
records.description: Save the replies, signatures, and AI prompts you use every week. On iOS and Android, switch to the ClipTap keyboard, choose a snippet, and tap Insert. On Apple silicon Macs, use a keyboard shortcut to insert it into a supported text field. Your snippets are stored locally. Save up to 50 templates for free, with no account needed.

records.name: Slime Browser
records.tagline: A browser that redraws any website the way you ask
records.description: Slime is a browser for Mac and Windows that redraws the sites you already use. Open Amazon, pick a look, and the same page comes back as a dating app, where the price is the product's age and the reviews are its exes. Or describe your own look in one sentence ("make Google look like it's 1998") and Slime builds it for that site. Looks only change how the page is drawn in your browser. Search, cart and sign-in stay the site's own, and one click goes back to the original. Free to start.

records.name: rimalux
records.tagline: Procedural wallpaper generator, designed for OLED screen
records.description: Rimalux is a minimalist AMOLED & OLED procedural wallpaper generator that creates crisp vector art on true black backgrounds. Instead of compressed stock photos, every wallpaper is generated on your device at your screen's native resolution, and you decide how much of it stays pitch black.

records.name: Ringways: Marble Ring Puzzle
records.tagline: Rotate rings to guide marbles to their gate. Calm
records.description: Ringways is a calm ring puzzle about rotating linked rings. Rotate rings, carry the colored marbles along, and send each marble out through the gate of its own color. It is a relaxing marble logic puzzle you can play offline, with no timer and no lives. How it works Rings overlap and share sockets, so a marble sitting where two rings cross can ride either one. Drag a ring to rotate it as many notches as you like. When the ring stops, every marble resting on a gate of its own color rolls out.

records.name: Aether for Trades
records.tagline: AI receptionist for busy tradespeople
records.description: Aether answers missed calls for UK plumbers, heating engineers and electricians while they’re on the tools. It captures customer and job details and emails them to you so you can call back when you’re free. Try a free live demo—no card needed. Plans start at £49/month.

records.description: In Japanese Here. 一度きりの夏に懸ける、機を待つ高校野球監督ゲーム。 あなたは高校野球部の監督。 基本放置、勝負所で采配をして勝利を目指します。 練習も試合も放置で進められるので1日5分で遊べます。 【機を待つ采配】 今年はエース主体で守り勝つか、大砲を主軸とした打棒で打ち勝つか。 選手の入部セレクションからあなたの采配は始まります。 選手たちの育成方針を決め、コーチとともに育成を進め、試合に臨みます。 送りバントか、強攻か。ここで代打か、スキルを使って畳みかけるか、まだ待つか。 試合は采配のみ可能で、選手たちが一球ずつプレイを重ねます。 最後に勝ちをつかめるよう、機を待ち、自分の勝ちパターンに相手を引き込めるでしょうか。 【こんな人におすすめ】 ・育成シミュレーションが好きな人 ・忙しくても、少しずつ遊べるゲームを探している人 ・野球が好きな人や特に甲子園をよく見る人 ・高校野球を見ながら「ここで代打だろ」「ここはバントしたらダメだろ」と思ってしまう采配にこだわりがある人 ・プレイ量や、課金量の差で勝ち負けが決まるゲームに疲れた人

records.name: askpeer
records.tagline: Ask your teammate's coding agent, without interrupting them
records.description: Code lives in Git, but WHY it changed lives inside your teammate's Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor sessions. askpeer syncs secret-redacted, repo-scoped summaries into a 3-tool MCP so your agent can ask @teammate's agent and get a cited answer in ~2s, 24/7 — even while their laptop is closed.

records.name: Whispet
records.tagline: A private health diary for your dog or cat
records.description: Whispet keeps your dog's or cat's vaccinations, medications, vet visits, weight and documents in one place. Dealing with a chronic condition? Templates for diabetes, glucose curves, epilepsy and digestion turn your entries into charts you can export to PDF or XLSX for your vet visit. No account, not on our servers, no tracking. Free plan for one pet; Premium adds more pets, unlimited photos and weight and journal entries. A diary and record, not a medical device.

records.name: Hypeclip
records.tagline: Turn your product URL into a launch video in minutes

Pick from 5 templates, edit the text, colors and track, and preview it free in your browser. One credit exports all three formats in HD plus 5 Product Hunt gallery images. Built for indie makers and small teams launching on Product Hunt, X, LinkedIn, Reels and TikTok.

records.name: techondicas.it.com

records.name: Slimly

records.name: Reeltopus
