records.tagline: One AI workspace for creation, work and productivity
records.description: Cavance is the all-in-one AI workspace that brings powerful AI models, creative tools and productivity apps together under one subscription. Chat with leading AI models, generate images and videos, create lifelike voiceovers, build websites, design presentations and work with documents, spreadsheets and designs — all in one seamless workspace. Less switching. Fewer subscriptions. More possibilities.

records.name: District Assurance
records.tagline: Open-source engine for trusted AI phone calls
records.description: An open-source TypeScript engine for automated phone lines that handle accounts, payments and doors. The model on the call can ask; only your code can say yes. It verifies the caller, files what they confirm, texts a payment link and records every step.

records.name: Purgy
records.tagline: Deep-clean your Mac: hidden files, System Data and AI models
records.description: Purgy finds what macOS hides: System Data, app leftovers, hidden folders, and unused AI models, and frees the safe part in one click. It also checks the important security settings of your Mac. Try it free for 3 days, then pay $20 once and use it for life.

records.name: BranPorts
records.tagline: Client portals that carry your name, not ours.
records.description: BranPorts gives agencies one place to run client work under their own brand and domain. Clients log in to your portal to send requests, approve work, sign documents, pay invoices and read monthly traffic reports built from Google Search Console and GA4, with a plain-English explanation of why traffic changed. Behind the scenes, you can route jobs to fulfillment partners without your clients ever seeing them. Proposals, time tracking, retainers and team chat are built in.

records.name: Taadyl
records.tagline: Website feedback, exactly where it belongs
records.description: Taadyl is the simplest way to collect website feedback from clients. Paste any website link and send your client a share link: guests open it without creating an account, click the exact spot and leave a comment, a voice note, a file or a drawing. Every comment arrives pinned in place with a screenshot, on desktop, tablet and phone. Assign, resolve, and send your developer a clean PDF. In English, French and Arabic.

records.name: ResumeMeow
records.tagline: See your resume through an interviewer’s eyes
records.description: Upload your resume and get a review of where a hiring manager might want more detail. ResumeMeow asks follow-up questions about the work you did, then turns your answers into edits you can accept or change. You leave with a clearer resume and practice explaining the same work in an interview. ResumeMeow is currently free to use.

records.name: Mubeen Khan
records.tagline: Meta & Google Ads + AI automation for $3K+/mo ad spenders
records.description: Meta Ads, Google Ads and AI automation that have generated $163M+ for 50+ brands in the UAE, USA, Australia and New Zealand. Mubeen Khan and his in-house team run performance campaigns, funnels, GoHighLevel CRM builds and AI voice/WhatsApp agents for businesses spending $3K+/month on ads, plus web design and video production. Free 30-minute strategy session before you commit to anything.

records.name: Wender Desktop
records.tagline: A 100% free Paper alternative
records.description: Wender Desktop is a 100% free HTML canvas design tool for Mac. Use your own agent subscriptions, own your files forever and self host on a free Cloudflare plan for sharing and collaboration, and work with your real code and components. No MCP limits. No seat limits.

records.name: Appstronaut
records.tagline: Ship, track & reply to your iOS apps from an Android phone
records.description: Appstronaut brings App Store Connect to Android. Get alerts when builds finish, reviews land or your app's review status changes. See daily sales trends, edit What's New and keywords, and handle TestFlight. All direct with Apple using your own API key, no server.

records.name: Notes by Webforgelabs
records.tagline: Private, offline, open-source notes for Android
records.description: Notes is a free, open-source Android app designed for privacy, simplicity, and productivity. Organize notes with folders and tags, use rich text, checklists and attachments, protect sensitive notes with biometrics, and export your data. Fully offline. No ads, no tracking, no accounts, no subscriptions.

records.name: FollowFlow
records.tagline: Privacy-first Instagram follower tracker, no Instagram login
records.description: Find who doesn't follow you back, see pending Instagram follow requests, and discover unfollowers and new followers by comparing saved analyses. FollowFlow processes your official Instagram data export locally on your device. No Instagram password, no direct account connection, and no upload of your imported Instagram data. Available on iOS with free features and optional subscriptions.

records.name: ZotGame
records.tagline: Free browser games. No downloads or signup.
records.description: ZotGame is a free browser game portal featuring solitaire, mahjong solitaire and bubble shooters, alongside other casual games. Browse collections, read game instructions and play online without downloads or registration.

records.name: Reveel
records.tagline: Interactive digital gifts they’ll actually remember
records.description: Reveel turns your photos and words into a gift they open as a link: a short interactive film made for one person. Pick a template (birthday, anniversary, graduation, just-because, or an Indian wedding invitation), add your photos and a letter, and send the link on WhatsApp or DM. They tap through it on their phone, with no app and no login. About 15 minutes to make. Gifts from ₹199, wedding invites ₹499.

records.name: GetMenuBloom
records.tagline: Snap your printed menu, get a QR menu in 30+ languages
records.description: Snap your printed menu and AI turns it into a QR code menu guests open on their phone, translated into up to 10 of 30+ languages. Enhance dish photos with AI for a food-magazine look. Guests save dishes to My list and show it to the waiter, so ordering is faster and waiters spend less time explaining dishes. Print QR table cards and change prices anytime, with no reprinting. Built for small restaurants and cafés with tourists.

records.name: The Silent Healing Room
records.tagline: A silent room with a witness to calm your mind & CNS.
records.description: Pick a length, sit in silence, and know a witness is in the room with you. No talking, no teaching, no selling — just a held space for your meditation, nervous system, and inner work. Free, open to all.

records.name: Andyfold
records.tagline: Three top AIs. One clean workspace.
records.description: Andyfold is a fast, clean AI workspace bringing ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini into dedicated, isolated tabs. Each model has its own independent chat history so your tasks never get mixed up. Switch models instantly, run live web search, and generate images or video without switching sites or paying multiple subscriptions. Free every day with generous daily allowances.

records.name: Tote
records.tagline: Help your AI find real Black Friday deals in your size
records.description: A free add-on for ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, and Gemini. Tell your AI your sizes and taste once, find real Black Friday deals with 90 days of price history, and get Deal Watch emails when prices drop. Tote never buys for you: you always check out yourself.

records.name: Dollar Download Store
records.tagline: Useful digital downloads, just $1 each
records.description: A shop where every download costs $1: planners, budget spreadsheets, classroom printables, coding flashcards and cheat sheets. Buy only what you need, with no subscription, and download after checkout. Digital files only, nothing shipped.

records.name: Keepfold
records.tagline: Saved. Sorted. Used. What you save comes back
records.description: You save it. You never see it again. Keepfold puts everything you save on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and the web in one place, sorts it for you, and brings it back when you can use it: a reminder near a café, cook mode, a Start button.

records.name: Multiverse Versus
records.tagline: Who would win? A fight simulator that shows its reasoning
records.description: Pick two characters from anime, manga, comics, films or games and get a simulated fight to the death, a win probability and the factors that decided it. A deterministic engine, not an AI opinion: one power scale for everyone, calibrated with fights from the original works. 11,552 characters, 100 franchises, every saga and form. Free, no sign-up, English and Spanish.

records.name: SurgeShorts
records.tagline: Find where chat exploded in a stream, export it as a short
records.description: Paste a Twitch, Kick or YouTube stream replay. SurgeShorts reads the whole chat, marks where it reacted most, ranks those moments and plays each one in the page. Export any part as a 9:16 short for TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Reels, or a 16:9 MP4 for your editor. Finding where chat reacted is free, with no sign-up. Made for clippers paid per 1,000 views, who need the best moment of an 8-hour stream fast. Also has an API and a CLI for AI agents.

records.name: Nexo Ledgerbox
records.tagline: Bank PDFs to QuickBooks/CSV with $0.00 proof & RAM-only
records.description: Convert native or scanned bank statement PDFs and receipt photos into QuickBooks, Xero, Excel (.xlsx), or CSV. Two-stage math checks prove $0.00 discrepancy before export, and files are wiped from RAM immediately with strict Zero Data Retention.

records.name: dailydev
records.tagline: A daily quiz on the code your AI writes for you
records.description: We don't really write code anymore. We prompt, skim the diff, hit accept. But do you still know what git rebase --onto does? What that Python one-liner prints? What the CSS you just shipped actually does? dailydev is 5 questions a day on the stuff your agent writes for you. Same puzzle for everyone, 15 seconds each, no autocomplete, no account. Just you, a green terminal, and the slow realisation you've been approving code you don't understand.

records.name: Mirov
records.tagline: MCP Native Social Network for Humans in the Agentic Era
records.description: Mirov is the first MCP-based social network, reshaping how humans can interact in the era of artificial intelligence. Connect it once to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or any MCP app and do it all from chat: build your profile, post to your timeline, message people across AI apps, find people by what they actually built, post and apply for jobs, sell services, launch products, run projects and join communities. Prove you're human with World ID. Nothing reaches others without your approval.

records.name: Samesake
records.tagline: Match customer records across systems without a shared ID
records.description: Samesake links customer records that belong to the same person, even when names, contact details or customer IDs differ. Review uncertain matches side by side and see why they were suggested. Each system keeps its own records, and your applications and workflows can use a shared person ID. Find linked records for GDPR subject access requests and track erasure across connected systems.

records.name: remove-bg
records.tagline: 100% Free AI Background Remover
records.description: Free online AI background remover and remove.bg alternative. Instantly make transparent PNGs, isolate squircle cards, and touch up with manual brush tools. since remove.bg is moving to canva, i decided to make this for everyone to use for free forever

records.name: LogRaker
records.tagline: Death by a thousand terminal tabs, cured
records.description: LogRaker is a native Mac app that tails your logs live from SSH servers, local files, Amazon CloudWatch, Amazon S3, Supabase and Google Cloud / Firebase. Put Streams side by side, read them in lock-step by time, and let Monitors tell you when something breaks, even on your Apple TV.

records.name: AI Live Chat PRO
records.tagline: Voice to voice AI Chat, AI Receptionist and CRM Connector
records.description: AI Live Chat Pro is a voice-to-voice chatbot & receptionist for WordPress and WooCommerce. It combines text chat and Instant Call, with voice powered by OpenAI GPT-Live-1. Connect Google Workspace Studio for advanced AI automation, CRM, email follow-ups and Google Sheets.

records.name: Stacktrace
records.tagline: Real-time steering and guardrails for AI agents
records.description: Stacktrace is a control layer for AI agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Devin. It reads their tool calls, blocks unsafe ones before they run, enforces the limits your team sets and steps in when an agent drifts from its intent.

records.name: OpenCrawl
records.tagline: Multiplayer for your coding agents
records.description: OpenCrawl lets your coding agents search each other's histories and talk to each other, across laptops and cloud coding environments. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and more. Open source, self-hostable and free to start.

records.name: StoryPass
records.tagline: Passwords you can picture: each one is a tiny story
records.description: StoryPass is a Mac menu-bar app that turns each password into a short sentence: a character, an action and a place, like "Spider-Man is whispering by the harbor". Every part is drawn by your Mac's cryptographic random generator, from about 127 billion possible stories. Built around NIST's current guidance, every StoryPass is 17+ characters, with no forced symbols. Paste it into the password manager you already use. No account, no network, no data collected.

records.name: Adlizer
records.tagline: Competitor ad alerts by WhatsApp and email
records.description: Adlizer shows active Meta and Google ad counts and examples. Follow competitors for email and WhatsApp alerts when ads change. Scan with Chrome, Firefox or Edge, or use the web panel. Pro adds LinkedIn scans for $39/year.

records.name: Promotio
records.tagline: Turn app screenshots into 3D mockups & promo videos
records.description: Your screens. In motion. Turn screenshots and screen recordings into 3D mockups and promo videos with Promotio, on iPhone, iPad and Mac. Start from a template or from scratch, place your screens on iPhone, iPhone Duo, iPad and MacBook models, animate the camera with keyframes, add taps, sounds, text and a realistic hand holding the device with studio or rim lighting. Export PNG or MP4 for the App Store, social media and your portfolio.

records.name: Easy IGCSE
records.tagline: Free IGCSE revision, cut to the exact specification
records.description: Free revision for International GCSE, built by a student sitting the exams in 2027. 164 lessons cut to the exact specification for Edexcel Biology, Chemistry, Physics and Business and Cambridge Computer Science and Geography. Each ends with a quiz, exam questions with full answers and links to the real past-paper questions. 224 interactive 3D diagrams, 109 required practicals in a virtual lab, and a tracker for every spec point. No account, no ads.

records.name: LearnXops Job Agent
records.tagline: AI agent that finds jobs, tailors your résumé and applies
records.description: Set the roles, seniority and locations you want. The Job Agent searches company career pages and job boards, scores each job against your profile, writes a tailored résumé and cover letter using only what is true in your profile, applies on employers' sites and logs it all in your Job Tracker. It hands you CAPTCHAs, sign-ins and questions only you can answer, and never applies on LinkedIn or Indeed. Runs in the LearnXops desktop app with your own AI provider. Pro and Lifetime.

records.name: TerraPoly
records.tagline: Build low-poly 3D worlds directly in your browser.
records.description: TerraPoly is a browser-based 3D world-building studio for game developers, designers and creative enthusiasts. Generate procedural terrain, sculpt landscapes, customise biomes, build roads, rivers and bridges, and control weather and lighting. Explore your creations in Play Mode or export them as GLB, OBJ and heightmaps for your next game or creative project. No complex 3D software required.

records.name: Hirecarta 2.0
records.tagline: Job search like a recruiter
records.description: Recruiters screen you on knockout questions, keywords, and competencies. Hirecarta shows you that same view of every job before you apply. Import any posting in one click into an organized tracker and get a resume tailored to each job. The more you tell Hirecarta, the better every resume gets. Free trial. No card.

records.name: JSON Wrench
records.tagline: Fix broken JSON in one click and see exactly what changed
records.description: Paste JSON that won't parse: trailing commas, single quotes, comments, Python dicts, JSON inside log lines. JSON Wrench explains the error in plain English, fixes it in one click and shows exactly what changed. It also formats, minifies and has a tree view. Free, no sign-up, nothing uploaded.

records.name: OYCA
records.tagline: Make your AI coding tool build like a senior team
records.description: OYCA is a skill set you install once into the AI coding tool you already use. Every project then runs in ten planned phases, from Define to Launch, and a phase closes only when its checks pass and a separate review signs it off. One payment, no account.

records.name: SchemaGuru
records.tagline: Your agent reads the names. SchemaGuru reads the data.
records.description: SchemaGuru gives AI agents the context that column names hide. It crawls your warehouse catalog, measures which joins really match and which values really occur, refuses join paths that multiply rows, masks PII by default and traces lineage from dbt and view SQL. Your agent gets a question-scoped, token-budgeted view through Python, a CLI, an MCP server or LangChain/LlamaIndex adapters. Open source (MIT), read-only, works without an LLM. Try it in the in-browser playground.

records.name: MyMeditationZone
records.tagline: Place calming nature sounds around you, in 3D
records.description: Sit in the middle of a little ink-drawn island and put rain, birdsong, a fire, crickets, frogs and the sea wherever you like: near or far, low or high. Each sound is rendered in 3D for headphones. Pick a world to look at (a raked garden, deep space, the Himalaya or a lotus lake), set a sleep timer or follow the breathing guide. Free, no sign-up, works offline, and keeps playing with your phone's screen off.

records.name: LGPD Cloud
records.tagline: Adequação LGPD e Governança de Dados Pessoais
records.description: LGPD Cloud: plataforma de adequação LGPD e governança de dados. Mapeamento de dados, RIPD, incidentes e gestão de riscos para a conformidade da empresa.

records.name: After the Relationship
records.tagline: Why does your love life keep repeating? Free chart
records.description: Astrologers read love from Venus, not from your sun sign. Enter your birth date (birth time is optional) and get a free birth chart about love: your Venus sign first, then the pattern that keeps repeating in how you love, each turned into a question you can actually answer. No account needed. If you want to go deeper, there's an optional personal report on your patterns in love, paid once. Astrology won't predict your future. It can help you ask better questions.

records.name: Storefindy
records.tagline: AI-powered store locator for websites and Shopify
records.description: Storefindy makes it easy for businesses to add and manage an interactive store locator on their websites and Shopify stores. With AI-powered location importing, cleaning, categorization, and geocoding, you can manage hundreds of locations with less manual work. Customers can search for stores, explore locations on an interactive map, view business hours and contact details, and get directions. No Google Maps API key required.

records.name: Playground Tracker
records.tagline: Your family's outdoor log, shared with your partner
records.description: A simple iPhone log for parents: who took the kids out, for how long and what they did. Fill in days you missed, mark days nobody went (rain, sick, busy), set up recurring plans like football on Mondays and add them to Calendar or Reminders. A Home Screen widget shows your streak. Invite your partner with a link and both phones stay in sync through iCloud. No account, no ads, no tracking, one purchase.

records.name: Noty
records.tagline: Private Side Panel Notes, Checklists & Bookmarks for Chrome
records.description: Noty is a fast, local-first Chrome Side Panel workspace for saving links, taking notes, and checking off tasks without leaving your tab. Capture pages with Alt+S, start notes with Alt+N, switch between Side Panel and Classic Popup in one click, and organize with color folders and #tags. Works 100% offline with zero sign-up or tracking, supports 6 languages (including Arabic RTL), and includes Ask My Notes powered locally by Chrome's built-in Gemini Nano AI with no cloud or API keys.

records.name: Dashlets
records.tagline: Turn your prompts into shared tools your team can use.
records.description: Turn your prompts into shared AI tools. You control the prompts, your team simply uses them. See who uses what, track adoption, and make sure everyone works with the AI tools you've designed. No more scattered prompts, duplicated work, or guessing how your team uses AI.

records.name: honeyletter
records.tagline: Good news for people tired of their feed
records.description: honeyletter is a daily good-news app. Every weekday at 7am, five true stories arrive in a sealed letter: real people, real places, and then it ends. No infinite scroll. Tap one button for something good anytime, and wander every story pinned on a map of the world, 1,000+ places so far. Keep a private jar of the good in your own days. Free, with honeyletter+ for the full map, search and unlimited good. iPhone and Android.

records.name: 30 Products in 30 Days
records.tagline: One finished product shipped every day for 30 days
records.description: A public challenge to ship one finished product every day for 30 days, starting 28 Nov 2026. Products can be digital, physical or a service, and each launch is announced with its own blog post. Follow along, build with me, pre-order products or sponsor the run.

records.name: HeyFonty
records.tagline: Discover and play with all the fonts you have with Fonty 🤩
records.description: Hey! 👋 I’m Fonty! 🤩 The little happy friendly font expert. Let’s explore the fonts you have on your Mac! Making a book cover? 📚 Give me the title and we’ll try it in a few faces side by side. When one catches your eye, ask me what goes with it. I’ll show you why the two get along and help you lay out the cover in Fonty Studio. 💛 And if you’ve ever wondered what a serif is, I’ll show you one right on the letter 👀

records.name: GrowNextAI
records.tagline: AI Marketing Assistant for Growing Businesses
records.description: Create social media content, WhatsApp campaigns, AI blogs, ads, customer replies and marketing campaigns faster with GrowNextAI — your AI marketing team for small and local businesses, in English, Hindi, Hinglish and more.

records.name: BeforeToday - Before & After
records.tagline: Before & After Reinvented
records.description: BeforeToday is a before & after camera with Smart Alignment. It compares the live view with your reference photo and tells you how to move until the frames match, so every comparison is captured from the exact same angle. Show real change over time, then export and share your results. Photos and videos stay on your device, with no generative AI. Available for iPhone, iPad and Android. Your first 3 comparisons are free.

records.name: ligungi
records.tagline: Play Gungi, the HUNTER×HUNTER board game, free online
records.description: Gungi is the tower-stacking strategy game from the HUNTER×HUNTER manga, released as a real board game in 2022. ligungi lets you play it free with the official rules: against the computer, or people in rated, casual and correspondence games, and every Saturday in the Weekly Arena. Learn with lessons, then race through puzzles in Puzzle Storm and Puzzle Racer. In the browser, the Windows app or a Discord call. No ads, no account needed, open source, in English, Portuguese and Spanish.

records.name: Tools by Cengiz Ilerler
records.tagline: Free tools for developers and everyday work, no uploads
records.description: 50+ small tools that run in your browser. For developers: compare two texts, convert JSON, YAML, XML and CSV, explain a cron expression, pick a code name, browse Material colors. For everyday work: merge and fill PDFs, mark up (including cut-out) and resize pictures, make a QR business card, generate a password, plan a call across time zones, compare a W-2 offer with 1099, look up Incoterms. Free, no account. What you open or paste stays on your computer: nothing is uploaded.

records.name: HeicFix
records.tagline: HEIC to JPG in one tap, right on your iPhone
records.description: iPhone photos are saved as HEIC, which Windows, Android and many upload forms can't open. HeicFix converts them to JPG, PNG or PDF in one tap, shrinks a photo to the exact KB limit a visa or job portal asks for, and combines scans into one PDF. Works from the Photos share sheet and in batches. Everything happens on your iPhone: nothing is uploaded, it works offline and can strip location data. Your first photo is free.

records.name: ShineBooking
records.tagline: Find beauty pros, book online, and run a CRM
records.description: ShineBooking is for clients looking for a beauty master or salon, and for the masters and salons who run the work. Clients in Ukraine search nearby for nails, hair, cosmetology, brows, and massage, then book a time online. Masters and salons keep the schedule, services, and client records in one CRM, so a booking does not start with a phone call.

records.name: PimPam
records.tagline: Blur sensitive data before you share your screen
records.description: PimPam is a free, open-source browser extension for Chrome, Edge and Firefox that hides sensitive data on any website before you share your screen or take a screenshot. Click any text to blur it, cover it with skeleton placeholders, or edit it to swap real client data for demo values. Made for sales demos, Zoom/Meet/Teams calls, docs and tutorials. Everything runs locally: no account, no servers, no tracking.

records.name: OpenOut
records.tagline: The link in bio that gets fans out of in-app browsers
records.description: Instagram and TikTok open your bio link in their own browser, where fans are signed out of everything. OpenOut is a link-in-bio page that spots that browser and offers a way out: on Android a tap tries Chrome, on iPhone a guided copy into Safari.

records.name: First Tap: Animals
records.tagline: Calm first app for toddlers: tap an animal, it comes alive
records.description: A calm first iPhone app for kids aged 1–4. Tap an animal and it comes alive, makes its sound and says its name. 72 lifelike animals in 6 worlds, voices in 15 languages. No ads, no subscriptions, works offline. 12 pets are free, the rest is one purchase.

records.name: سعودي | Saudi
records.tagline: AI technical proposals for Saudi tenders
records.description: Saudi lists open Saudi government tenders from Etimad every day and prepares a ready, editable Arabic technical proposal for each one, aligned with the Government Tenders and Procurement Law. Buyers can build a full 12-section RFP or start from sector templates. Instant tender alerts on Telegram, free 7-day trial. كن أول من ينجح — منصة المناقصات والعروض الفنية الذكية في السعودية.

records.name: Pronouns in Maps
records.tagline: Vote on the pronouns for the world’s cities, oceans and seas
records.description: A map where anyone can vote on the pronouns of about 4,750 cities, oceans and seas. Pick as many as fit from every set in the Gender Census 2025, and see tags like she/they appear on the map. No accounts, and IP addresses are never stored. A Tampermonkey overlay also shows the results on Google Maps. Inspired by the "woke is back" euphoria after the 2026 midterms.

records.name: Kan Lazım
records.tagline: Turkey's urgent blood request board, in Turkish
records.description: Kan Lazım is a free, Turkish-language board for urgent blood requests across all 81 provinces of Turkey. Someone at a hospital posts a request in about a minute with no account; volunteer donors filter by city and blood type and call. Every request is moderated on the server, points to one of more than 1,500 real hospitals and retires after 72 hours. The patient's phone number is never public, and donors can get alerts for matching requests nearby. No ads, no trackers.

records.name: TravelFeed Hosting 2.0
records.tagline: A travel blog without the WordPress hassle
records.description: Starting a travel blog usually means WordPress: hosting, a theme, plugins for SEO, maps and galleries, then updates and backups forever. TravelFeed is a hosted blog made only for travel, with nothing to install. Tell the Site Builder what you want, like "make it look like a vintage travel magazine", and see it in a preview. Destination pages build themselves from your posts, and SEO, speed, security and backups are handled for you.

records.name: Elathi SmartPOS
records.tagline: GST billing and stock software for Indian shops, offline
records.description: Billing software for Indian shops on your own Windows PC. Bill by barcode, name or voice in 6 languages, print thermal or A4 GST bills, track stock, credit and supplier bills. Works without internet, your data stays on the PC. Free 7-day trial. Launch offer: half price for the first 100 shops.

records.name: Webdesly Passport
records.tagline: Serial, materials and service history for maisons
records.description: Quiet identity desk for maisons: serials, materials and origin, a public passport page, and view events on a Today desk. Not a resale authentication lab, not NFC hardware. Free public passport demo, no signup.

records.name: Meditation Essential Oil Trio
records.tagline: Tea tree, frankincense and lavender essential oil trio
records.description: Rootsar Meditation is a trio of tea tree, frankincense and lavender essential oils, made to cover your daily routine. Use them separately or together.

records.name: CleanPDF PDF to JPG
records.tagline: Turn PDF pages into JPG images, right in your browser
records.description: Convert all pages, a range or specific pages of a PDF into JPG images. Pick 300 DPI for print or 72-150 DPI for web, four quality levels, colour, grayscale or black and white, and even JPEG 2000 or JPEG XL. Preview pages, then download them one by one or as a single ZIP. Your file stays on your device. Free, no sign-up.

records.name: Zonified Rank
records.tagline: AI SEO that plans, writes and publishes your content
records.description: Enter your domain and Zonified Rank works out what you sell and who you compete with, then builds a 30-day organic growth and content plan. It writes each post, publishes it to WordPress or Shopify, shares it to LinkedIn and tracks it in Google Search Console. One switch decides whether a person approves each post before it goes live. Plans include 1 blog post per day: $149/month or $1,199/year.

records.name: DashJoy Studio
records.tagline: Play free browser games instantly, no download needed
records.description: DashJoy Studio is a fast, lightweight web gaming portal where you can play thousands of free browser games directly on desktop, tablet, or mobile. No downloads or accounts required—just click and play across puzzle, action, racing, strategy, and 2-player genres.

records.name: Dev Stack
records.tagline: One command to run your whole local dev stack
records.description: One command to run a complete local development stack on macOS and Windows — nginx, Apache, PHP 8.5/8.3/7.4, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis and Mailpit, with clean *.test URLs and native control apps for both platforms.

records.name: Mandarin Lab
records.tagline: Train Mandarin tone pairs & Pinyin traps
records.description: Mandarin Lab helps adult beginners train real connected Mandarin speech—not isolated textbook syllables. Practice all 20 two-syllable tone pairs (including half-third tones and 3+3 sandhi), drill English-speaker Pinyin traps like zh/ch/sh vs. z/c/s, take a free diagnostic tone test, and compare your own browser-only recordings with live pitch contours. Uses synthetic Mandarin voices. Try core drills free with no signup, or unlock everything with a $9 one-time pack—no subscription.

records.name: Dental Implant Calc
records.tagline: See dental implant costs before you sit in the chair
records.description: A free U.S. dental implant cost calculator. Pick tooth count, material, add-ons like bone grafts or extractions, and region to get a price range with a line-by-line breakdown. Built from published, dated and cited market data. Compare costs by state and explore an open 50-state access-gap study. No email, phone number or sign-up. Estimates only, not quotes or medical advice.

records.name: BlueSales
records.tagline: AI Receptionist & AI Outbound Calling for Small Business
records.description: BlueSales is an AI phone agent for small businesses. It answers inbound calls 24/7 and books appointments into Google Calendar or Outlook. It also runs outbound campaigns from your own lead lists (qualification, reminders, winbacks, surveys) and calls new web-form leads within seconds. Built-in consent tracking, calling-hour limits and do-not-call lists. Works with Zapier, n8n, WordPress, MCP and a REST API.

records.name: Agent Fit Check
records.tagline: Would an AI agent get through your business?
records.description: People are launching AI agents to research, book, buy, and get support. Agent Fit Check scores whether agents can finish Discover → Decide → Transact → Support → Continue on your site — then gives you a free fix prompt, or a $999 done-for-you pass for one primary journey delivered as a PR you review and merge.

records.name: SqftPlan
records.tagline: Square footage & US renovation material calculators.
records.description: Measure a room or L-shaped floor plan once, then carry your net square footage into five US renovation estimators: drywall (4×8/4×12 sheets), carpet (12-ft rolls & sq yd), flooring (10%/15% waste & whole boxes), exterior paint (350 sq ft/gal & 5-gal pails), and shower tile (unfolded 3-wall SVG). Includes 2026 DIY vs. Pro cost presets, editable unit prices, and one-click shopping lists. 100% browser-only — no accounts, no contractor lead forms.

records.name: GIG 3.0
records.tagline: Match freelancers to AI and data projects without bidding
records.description: GIG 3.0 helps staffing agencies match clients and freelancers for AI and data projects. AI interviews capture what each side wants, then GIG proposes a match and an hourly rate for both to review. Try the prototype from either side and follow a project from the first conversation to a proposed contract.

records.name: Postyfy
records.tagline: Auto-post to Facebook groups from your own account
records.description: Postyfy is a desktop app for macOS and Windows that posts to the Facebook groups you've joined, from your own account. Pick a post and a list of groups, set a schedule, and it works through them with pauses between groups. Each group gets its own wording via spintax or AI. It also finds groups by city and topic and keeps a screenshot report for every group. Pro runs up to 5 accounts at once, each in its own browser profile. 5 days free, no card.

records.name: RoomCats
records.tagline: Lofi radio and four cats to keep you company while you work
records.description: RoomCats is a small room to keep open in a browser tab while you work: a lofi radio and four cats. More a room to keep open than a game. Free, no download, no sign-up; gifts for the cats are optional.

records.name: Dax
records.tagline: The human harness for AI coding agents
records.description: Agents have harnesses. Now you do too. Dax runs Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Cursor Agent side by side in one Mac window, in real terminals, on your Mac or on a server over SSH, and they keep going when you close it. Dax Companion for iPhone shows which agent needs you, so you can answer it and send the next prompt from anywhere. Plus menu-bar accelerators: secrets agents use without seeing, scheduled agent runs, a file drawer, prompt snippets and Ask AI.

records.name: Philoq People Finder
records.tagline: Find co-founders, Friends & partners across the web with AI
records.description: Finding the right person online shouldn't take weeks of cold DMs and noisy feeds. Philoq uses AI and human-assisted discovery to search across major platforms and bring you curated matches for any goal—whether you're looking for a co-founder, mentor, hire, travel buddy, or relationship partner. Create a private search brief, keep every goal isolated in its own workspace, and let Philoq do the heavy lifting.

records.name: Everchapel
records.tagline: A cathedral you can walk into from your phone
records.description: Some nights you can't get to a church, but you still want to be in one. Everchapel is a vast stained-glass cathedral in your browser. Walk the nave, sit in a pew, light a candle for someone and send it to them. Pray the Rosary or Compline with chant, hear the day's homily, talk with the sisters and brothers who keep the place. The confessional has an AI priest: it says so at the door and nothing is saved. Free, no account, open all night.

records.name: Riff
records.tagline: AI-driven investor perspectives on 6 stories every 6 hours
records.description: See what an investor might notice in today’s news. Riff uses AI to look at real news stories through the ideas investors have shared publicly, showing what they might pay attention to and why. You can check the sources behind each take.

records.name: Stream Panel
records.tagline: Complete Self-Hosted Streaming Management Software
records.description: Stream Panel: self-hosted streaming software with qBittorrent Torrent Manager, MediaFlow, HLS and AceStream proxy controls, VOD auto-import, Android app, reseller storefronts, billing and EPG. No licensed content service supplied.

records.name: RetroFC
records.tagline: Fantasy football with real Serie A seasons from the past
records.description: Build your squad at a live auction with real players from historic Serie A seasons, from 1985 onwards. Every goal, assist and card really happened. Play solo against bots or with friends, vote on the rules and replay the golden era of Italian football.

records.name: MapMyPDF
records.tagline: Free PDF tools that never upload your files
records.description: A private PDF shouldn't have to leave your device just to get merged or compressed. MapMyPDF does the work in your browser: merge, split, compress, convert, and clean up files without an upload or an account. Load the page once, then switch off your internet and keep working. The icon in the bottom-right corner shows when the offline tools are ready.

records.name: Lantern Promos
records.tagline: Find discount codes with your AI assistant
records.description: Check for a discount before you check out. Connect Lantern Promos to ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity or another supported AI assistant, then ask for codes for the store you're shopping at. Lantern Promos is free; some assistants require a paid plan to connect. Setup instructions are on our site.

records.name: Crownverge
records.tagline: Free medieval real-time strategy in your browser
records.description: Crownverge is a free medieval real-time strategy game for desktop browsers, no download. Shape a home town that grows between battles, play story missions with objectives, advisors and rewards, and fight fair 1v1 matches against real players: quick search, ranked seasons or a private room for a friend. Gather, build, train and outplay in real time. Early access from a solo developer, updated often.

records.name: NeonBlade UI
records.tagline: Free and open-source futuristic React UI component library
records.description: NeonBlade UI is a free and open-source React component library dedicated to futuristic, neon, cyberpunk, and sci-fi-inspired interfaces. Built with React and Tailwind CSS, it features neon glows, sharp edges, dynamic effects, and subtle animations. Highly customizable and equipped with a CLI, it lets you bring your futuristic UI ideas to life.

records.name: Snibbly Games — I Know Your Age
records.tagline: Guess your exact age in 12–24 cultural clues, no signup
records.description: Snibbly Games is an indie browser mini-game site. I Know Your Age guesses your age from 12–24 adaptive nostalgia clues—no birthday, camera or signup—and offers Internet Age, a Memory Strata chart and shareable results. Also play Guess My Age Quiz and I Know Your Country. Free on mobile and desktop, with 7 cultural editions for the flagship quiz.

records.name: Barello
records.tagline: The home cellar and bar app that picks tonight's bottle
records.description: Barello is a home cellar and bar app that tells you what to open tonight, what to keep, and what you can mix from what you have. Photograph a label and it reads it. You check it and save. Tell it where each bottle lives and it works out when each wine's at its best there. It checks its cocktail recipes against your shelf and shows what you can pour now. One cellar the whole house shares. Free on iPhone, Android and the web. Look around a sample cellar first, no account needed.

records.name: MotifQR
records.tagline: QR codes people actually want to scan
records.description: MotifQR is a QR code studio for codes that look like they belong to your brand. Put the code inside a shape, add your logo, give it 3D depth or style it from a text prompt, and a live check tells you it still scans. Make it dynamic to change the destination after printing, point it at a hosted Smart Page, and see scans by day, country and device. The studio is free with no signup, and the free plan includes dynamic codes and a hosted page.

records.name: MealBudget
records.tagline: Eat for a week on €25: menus, recipes & shopping list
records.description: MealBudget plans a full week of meals around your budget. Enter how much you can spend, how many people you cook for, your kitchen equipment, time and diet: it builds a 7-day menu with simple recipes and a grouped shopping list with estimated prices. Swap any meal for a cheaper, faster or simpler one, tick items off in store, and edit prices yourself. Made for students and small budgets in France (app in French). Free plan, Premium €3.99/month.

records.name: Why Do Your Plans Always Fail?
records.tagline: You Have Goals. So Why Aren't You Achieving Them?
records.description: Keep making plans but never seem to finish them? Discover the habits, mistakes, and mindset patterns that may be holding you back. Learn practical strategies to overcome procrastination, stay consistent, and turn your goals into action.

records.name: Lidwork
records.tagline: Close the lid. Your Mac and your agent keep working.
records.description: Keeps a MacBook awake with the lid closed, on battery, so coding agents, builds and uploads finish. Stops at your battery limit, when it gets too hot, or after 1, 4 or 8 hours. If it quits or crashes, sleep comes back. Free on the Mac App Store through Cyber Monday (Dec 1), then $9.99 once.

records.name: Screenshopped
records.tagline: Share any post or screenshot, find where to buy everything
records.description: See something you want in a post, a video or on someone in the street? Share the screenshot, photo or whole Instagram, TikTok or Pinterest post to Screenshopped. It identifies every item, finds where to buy each one and what it costs, and saves your picks to a wishlist. You then get alerts when a saved item drops in price or comes back in stock, cheaper alternatives for anything over budget, and shareable lists where friends can reserve gifts.

records.name: One More Minute
records.tagline: A satirical game where AI gives you back 24 hours a day
records.description: What if AI actually saved you 24 hours a day? One More Minute is a free narrative incremental game disguised as an AI productivity app. Start with a cluttered inbox, train your assistant, unlock upgrades and delegate more of your life. Every minute saved brings you closer to an unsettling question: what happens when there's nothing left to do? Play in your browser. No account, no downloads. Go in blind.

records.name: TheSCI Coach
records.tagline: 0%-commission Coaching ERP & 304K+ Live NTA CBT Exam Suite
records.description: TheSCI Coach is a white-label, 0%-commission Coaching ERP & 304,000+ Question Live NTA CBT Exam Studio for JEE, NEET, UPSC & Board academies. Stop losing 10-15% of fees to aggregators: run 8 ERP modules (CRM, GST Fees, Attendance, Batches, CBT Exams, LMS, Parent App, Analytics) on your own domain with PostgreSQL RLS data ownership. Flat INR plans start at ₹11,999/yr (Question Studio) & ₹84,000/yr (Full ERP). Built by TheSCI (thesci.co | thesci.co.in).

records.name: WatchDeploy
records.tagline: Catch broken sign-ups and checkouts after every deploy
records.description: Daily and post-deploy checks of signup, login and checkout for apps built with Lovable, Bolt, Cursor and Claude Code — plus a free security scan for leaked API keys and open databases.

records.name: Tickrivo
records.tagline: Backtesting & Prop Challenge Simulator
records.description: Bar-by-bar manual backtesting for forex, futures and crypto perpetuals, with a prop firm challenge simulator for daily loss, maximum loss and profit target rules. Simulation only; no real money.

records.name: Do I? Decision Journal
records.tagline: A daily decision journal: ask yourself, see your answer
records.description: Should I quit my job? Move cities? Break up? Ask once and you get a mood. Ask every day and you get an answer. Do I? is a private decision journal for iPhone. Write down the question you're stuck on, then come back each day and vote between your two answers, with a note, mood or photo. Over the weeks, the split shows what you keep choosing. No account, no server, no AI advice: everything stays on your phone. Free, in English and Chinese.

records.name: PitchForm
records.tagline: Apple Watch football tracker with heat maps and an AI coach
records.description: Record your match on Apple Watch or iPhone, then see where you ran on the pitch, your sprints, top speed and heart rate. After every match, a coach gives you one thing to fix next time. Free to record, map and share; Pro adds full coach reads, trends and sprint maps.

records.name: RELiCON
records.tagline: Find deals and coupon codes, compare prices before you buy
records.description: RELiCON is a deal discovery and price comparison platform. Shoppers find coupon codes and deals from stores worldwide and compare prices before buying on the store's own website. It also runs a free creator program: creators share store links and earn when shoppers buy through them.

records.name: Utilvance Salary Calculator
records.tagline: Hourly to salary and take-home pay. Free, no sign up.
records.description: Convert hourly pay to salary and back. Estimate take-home pay for the US, UK, Australia and Canada, check what a raise is worth after tax and work out pro rata pay. No account, no email, no subscription. Built by Sohaib Younas at utilvance.com.

records.name: Alvu
records.tagline: AI that searches thousands of jobs and tailors your résumé
records.description: Alvu's AI searches thousands of jobs from job boards, agencies and company career pages, finds the ones that match you and writes a tailored résumé for each one. Start with or without a résumé. Works in 10 languages.

records.name: GTA 6 Safe Code
records.tagline: Find the right safe clue without pausing the hunt
records.description: A free, independent browser companion for Grand Theft Auto VI. Search by landmark, mission, or clue to find a safe, copy a fixed combination with its leading zero intact, or see which prompt reveals a variable code. Each entry links to the gameplay source, and regional pages group nearby safes.

records.name: WordWeave: Crossword Puzzles
records.tagline: Classic crossword puzzles with real clues, easy to hard
records.description: WordWeave is a classic crossword puzzle game with real clues, across and down, on a clean grid that is easy to read on a phone. Solve 200 crossword puzzles that grow from easy to hard, play a new daily crossword every day, and climb the weekly leaderboard.

records.name: CleanPDFTools
records.tagline: Free local PDF tools in your browser. Zero file uploads.
records.description: 20 free PDF tools that run 100% locally inside your browser tab using a ~140 KB Rust WebAssembly kernel and pdf-lib. Compress bloated PDFs, truly destroy redacted text, scrub XMP metadata, sign, flatten, and convert offline with zero uploads or paywalls.

records.name: Gateway Browser
records.tagline: Gateway A New Dimension of Browsing.
records.description: Experience the internet in a whole new dimension. Gateway replaces traditional tab-based browsing with an interactive spatial environment where websites and digital destinations live in dedicated visual spaces called gates. Stay organized, move between destinations naturally, and explore a more immersive way to browse. Built for digital explorers, multitaskers and anyone ready to go beyond tabs.

records.name: Larpr
records.tagline: Keep your tech skills sharp in the age of AI
records.description: Larpr is daily practice for developers who don't want vibe coding to erode their skills. Five minutes a day: a fresh challenge across 7 tracks (programming, DS&A, architecture, AI, DevOps, security, digital skills) with bug hunts, system diagrams, terminal drills and code you run in the browser. Plus illustrated roadmaps, No-AI timed builds, monthly skill checks, async duels and verified certificates for LinkedIn.

records.name: Monsey
records.tagline: Money that never leaves your phone - offline budget tracker
records.description: Monsey is a calm, private money manager with no account and no server: your financial data stays on your phone. Log spending by typing, by voice or by scanning a receipt (all on-device), set category budgets with a month-end forecast, track savings goals, and see your net worth in a 5-tier asset tower. Face ID lock, home screen widgets, 6 languages. Free to use; Pro is a one-time $9.99, no subscription. iPhone and Android.

records.name: Linkbase
records.tagline: A page for your personal brand,business and content
records.description: Linkbase is a web app for building your own page and putting it at one address. Share that address in your social media bios, messages, email signature or printed material, and people find your links, information and ways to reach you in one place. It works for creators, freelancers, small businesses, organisations and agencies. You don't need to know how to code. Let visitors see your available times and book or request appointments. Grow your email list and show your products or services.

records.name: SmartText
records.tagline: Free text expander for Chrome & Firefox | Unlimited snippets
records.description: SmartText is a free, privacy-first text expander for Chrome and Firefox. Looking for a Text Blaze, Magical or TextExpander alternative? Turn keyboard shortcuts into canned responses, email templates, signatures, code snippets and dynamic text instantly. Create unlimited snippets, organize folders, use rich text and variables, search your library, and import or export templates. Built for customer support, sales, developers and anyone who types all day. No account or subscription. Local storage.

records.name: YojanaPost
records.tagline: Government Schemes & Citizen Welfare Portal
records.description: YojanaPost is an independent, bilingual (English & Hindi) citizen welfare portal that helps Indian citizens discover, verify, and apply for Central and State Government schemes without confusion.

records.name: Peptmate
records.tagline: A free peptide tracker for iPhone, Android and the web
records.description: Peptmate keeps your peptide record in one place: dose reminders, one-tap logging, vial tracking, mood and weight logs, a journal and a plain-language library. It records; it never suggests a dose. Not medical advice.

records.name: Educational Kids Learning Game
records.tagline: Toddler ABC 123 Preschool App
records.description: Educational Kids Learning Game is a cheerful playground of 95 games for little learners: ABCs, numbers and math, memory, logic, puzzles, adventures, art and music – plus Track Builder, the train puzzle where kids fix the railway and send the engine to the finish flag. TRACK BUILDER Every puzzle is a short railway with pieces missing. Kids choose the track piece that fits – straight or curved – drop it into place and tap GO! The steam engine rolls along to the finish flag.

records.name: AI GIS AGENT
records.tagline: AI-Powered free GIS Agent  for QGIS
records.description: AI GIS AGENT is a free, open-source AI-powered plugin for QGIS. Simply describe what you want to achieve in natural language, and the AI does the work for you. Automate geoprocessing, spatial analysis, cartography, machine learning, project inspection, validation, and internet research through MCP integration. Custom QGIS plugins, GIS automation tools, and tailored AI solutions are also available for businesses and professionals.

records.name: SessionGraph
records.tagline: Visualize your coding agent history
records.description: Bring your sessions from your favorite harness, explore and visualize in a graph. Compare with your friends.

records.name: plumes
records.tagline: Record a birdsong, name the bird, grow your collection
records.description: Hear a bird and wonder what it is? plumes names it and keeps it. Tap record and BirdNET, the Cornell Lab's bird sound model, identifies the species in seconds. Every find joins your collection with the date, the place and a rarity tier from common to legendary. Badges, a daily streak and a weekly ranking with friends keep you going outside to listen. For curious walkers and keen birders alike. Free, no install, in English, Spanish and French. Your recordings never leave your phone.

records.name: Smart Notch
records.tagline: Dynamic Island for Windows, now with free live lyrics
records.description: New since our first launch: live lyrics that follow the song word by word and a fullscreen listening room with 9 lyric styles, now free for everyone. Smart Notch adds a Dynamic Island to the top of your Windows screen: now playing from any player, CPU, RAM and battery, clipboard history and a focus timer. Free on the Microsoft Store, about 1% CPU when idle.

records.name: Beat Chess! Coach
records.tagline: Chess coaches that explain every move, from 800 to Stockfish
records.description: Play 14 coaches, from an 800-rated beginner to full-strength Stockfish, who react to every move you make. Get hints when you're stuck and take back mistakes. Every move is graded, and the review shows why a move was a mistake and what was better. Add your Lichess or Chess.com username to find the mistakes you keep repeating. Stockfish runs on your device, with no account needed. Free to start; one $2.99 purchase unlocks everything, no subscription.

records.name: ExtSpace
records.tagline: Free Chrome extensions for everyday tasks
records.description: ExtSpace is a catalog of free, single-purpose Chrome extensions — PDF unlock and form filling, video trimming, image and audio conversion, fonts, timers, world clock and more. Everything runs locally in the browser: no account, no upload. One optional Pro subscription unlocks unlimited use of every extension.

records.name: YELLOWE
records.tagline: Stay ahead of returns, free trials, subscriptions
records.description: YELLOWE helps you stay ahead of shopping returns, free trials, memberships, and subscription renewals before deadlines cost you money. Organize reminders in one place, track Money at Risk, and get notified before time runs out. Available on iPhone and Android. Free to download with a 7-day YELLOWE+ trial, then $2.99/month or $24.99/year. Auto-renews unless canceled.

records.name: Ladybird Agentic
records.tagline: Native C++ browser for AI agents, hardened for humans
records.description: Derived from Ladybird with an embedded C++ MCP server (58 tools + SSE), ephemeral containers, live tab migration, WebMCP, SEP-2640 Skills, AES-256-GCM Blind Vault, and Agent Security Shield v2 against prompt injection. Zero Chromium, zero CDP.

records.name: VisBench
records.tagline: Probe any vision backbone across computer vision tasks
records.description: VisBench is an open-source Python library for finding out what a vision backbone actually encodes. It fits small probes on frozen features from DINOv2, CLIP, SigLIP, MAE, ConvNeXt, ResNet or your own PyTorch model, across 20 tasks from classification and segmentation to depth, camera pose, edges and orientation. Every run records exactly how its number was produced, so results measured differently are never ranked together. Free and open source: pip install visbench.

records.name: Reachify
records.tagline: Find the people behind your next job.
records.description: Stop sending applications into the void. Reachify helps you connect with people working at the companies you're applying to. Paste a job link. Reachify finds relevant employees, prioritises closer connections, and drafts personalised outreach emails using your resume. • Find employees at target companies • Write personalised emails • Send via your Gmail • Automated follow-ups • Approve every email before sending Start free with 3 companies. No credit card needed.

records.name: VidPulse AI
records.tagline: Turn any topic into a complete faceless YouTube video
records.description: VidPulse AI turns any topic into a complete, ready-to-upload faceless YouTube video — automatically. It writes the script, generates a natural AI voiceover in Urdu, English and more, builds visuals scene by scene, adds kinetic captions, and renders up to 120 minutes on your own PC. NEW: Niche Copier copies a winning video's format; Translation & Dubbing turns English videos into any language. unlimited videos, JazzCash/Easypaisa.

records.name: Rella
records.tagline: Client management for therapists and coaches in Canada
records.description: Rella follows each client from first enquiry to paid invoice. Enquiry board, online booking, reminders, intake forms, notes, video sessions, invoices, session packages and a business phone with texting, all in one place. Built for therapists, coaches and service businesses in Canada and the USA. Free for up to 3 active clients, with no card or time limit. Hosted in Canada, in English and French.

records.name: clip
records.tagline: I built a CLI tool that copies text from files.
records.description: Stop opening documents just to copy text. Clip is a free, open-source CLI that extracts text from 13 file formats directly to your clipboard in a single command. Built for developers, researchers, and terminal enthusiasts. Fast, private, and cross-platform — no uploads, no unnecessary clicks.

records.name: Touching Towns
records.tagline: From Booking to Boarding, We've Got You.
records.description: Touching Towns is an all-in-one travel booking platform helping travellers discover and book hotels, flights, homestays, villas and holiday homes across India and worldwide. Compare hotel prices, flight fares, amenities and travel options with transparent pricing, clear cancellation policies and secure payments. Plan your journeys with cab travel planning and TIVA AI, your smart AI travel planner. Make every trip simpler with Touching Towns!

records.name: Five Minutes: Break & Work Log
records.tagline: 100% offline screen break timer and work hours timesheet
records.description: Do you spend hours working at a computer monitor in the office or remotely from home? Under European and Polish occupational health and safety regulations (EU Directive 90/270/EEC and Polish Labor Law), every employee working at a screen is entitled to at least a 5-minute paid ergonomic break after every 60 minutes of screen work.

records.name: Pixl Face Liveness Check
records.tagline: Browser-Based Passive Liveness Detection SDK
records.description: Browser-based, client-side passive face liveness and anti-spoofing SDK. 468-point facial mapping, dual-model anti-spoof ensemble, and 16-frame temporal voting. No camera frame ever leaves the device.

records.name: SoMockup
records.tagline: Turn your UI image mock-up into real HTML
records.description: Convert a PNG or JPEG UI mock-up, Figma export or screenshot into semantic, responsive Bootstrap 5 HTML. USD 5 per mock-up (₹500 in India): 95% fidelity guaranteed or no money is taken.

records.name: Oxrion
records.tagline: Ship PHP code without giving away the source
records.description: Oxrion encrypts and signs PHP source code so you can ship it without giving it away. Protected files stay plainphp files and run on every supported PHP version, on Linux and Windows. With OPcache they run as fast as plain PHP. Add licenses per domain that you sign offline, server lock and expiry dates. Your private keys never leave your computer. Protect in the browser, the desktop app or from the command line. Free plan available.

records.name: RME: Private PDF Scanner 1.8.0
records.tagline: Split book scans and turn paper tables into spreadsheets
records.description: Photograph an open book and split it into two searchable pages. Turn a printed table into CSV, receipts into Excel reports, and scans into Word or PowerPoint files. RME 1.8.0 also lets you review OCR against the original, fill PDF forms and add a handwritten signature. Scanning and OCR run on Android without an account.

records.name: Dr. Yatin J Patel
records.tagline: Sleep Apnea & CPAP Book by Dr. Yatin J. Patel
records.description: CPAP Is Sexy, the new sleep apnea book by sleep physician Yatin J. Patel, MD with real stories. Out Nov 3, 2026 – ebook $0.99 Nov 3–10.

records.name: MapOfGrowth
records.tagline: Discover businesses around you and help each other grow
records.description: MapOfGrowth is a free interactive map where entrepreneurs, startups and businesses can discover each other locally and globally. Share what you can offer, find businesses that can help you with what you're missing, connect, chat and grow together. No random networking events or unnecessary pressure. Just real people and businesses helping each other move forward.

records.name: FamilyLoc
records.tagline: The family locator that never sells your location
records.description: Live family map, a notification when your kid gets to school or home, SOS and family chat. Kids join with a code, no email needed. No ads, nothing sold, history wiped automatically. Free for a parent + 1. Built by a dad who works in cybersecurity.

records.name: Scout My Business
records.tagline: Google Maps Rank Tracker – Your First Scan Is Free
records.description: Discover where your business ranks on Google Maps with Scout My Business. Track keyword rankings, visualize local SEO performance through geo-grid heatmaps, monitor competitors, and identify opportunities to improve local search visibility. Get your first grid scan completely free!

records.name: SonoJS
records.tagline: React UI you can copy, customize, and keep
records.description: React components, blocks, charts, and cursors for Tailwind apps. Add with the SonoJS CLI or generate UI via MCP.

records.name: ImgTulip
records.tagline: See how heavy your Shopify product images really are
records.description: Paste any Shopify store address and see its heaviest product images: file size, dimensions and format, free and with no sign-up. Then fix them with the ImgTulip app: bulk or automatic compression and resizing, with every original backed up and restorable.

records.name: Easy Oldies 2
records.tagline: Vintage & Retro Photo Effects
records.description: Easy Oldies 2 is the revival of a 13-year-old desktop application, now brought to iPhone and iPad. Give your photos a nostalgic look with nine different color variations inspired by classic photographic effects. Simply import a picture, browse the nine filtered thumbnails, and select the one you like best. Once you've made your selection, you can save the filtered image as a PNG file at its original resolution or copy it to the system clipboard for use in other apps.

records.name: ZeroCode Studio
records.tagline: Website Development Subscription
records.description: ZeroCode Studio gives teams experienced Webflow developers, WordPress development services and expert Shopify developers on a monthly subscription.

records.name: KaiPDF
records.tagline: PDF tools that run in your browser, so files never upload
records.description: Free PDF tools that run in your browser, so files never leave your device. Compress, edit, merge, sign, redact and OCR, plus AI quizzes.

records.name: IOSpec
records.tagline: See if a local LLM fits in your Mac's memory
records.description: IOSpec lives in your Mac's menu bar and tells you whether a local model fits in memory: Fits, Tight or Won't fit, per model, with a check for the next one you plan to load. The menu bar strip shows the readings you pick, as numbers or bars. A floating panel stays on top while you work, with layouts for AI models, heat and power. Also temperatures, fans, memory pressure, GPU, alerts and widgets. Works with Ollama, LM Studio and MLX. Apple Silicon, macOS 26+. Free for 14 days.

records.name: Vyber
records.tagline: Personal apps for your iPhone, made from a sentence
records.description: There's an app for everything, except the one you want. So describe it: "a reading log with pages per day", "a rest timer for my lifts", "four in a row for two". Vyber makes it in about a minute, and it runs on your iPhone, offline. Point at any part and say what to change. Or start from 20 ready-made ones: trackers, logs, budgets and games. Send one to a friend and they get their own copy. No account, no ads, and your data stays on your phone.

records.name: ReciBot
records.tagline: Save a recipe. Cook it hands-free.
records.description: Hundreds of saved recipes and the same four dinners? Share a recipe post, link, screenshot or PDF to ReciBot and get just the recipe, ready to cook. Snap your fridge and get dinner ideas from what's there. Fill the gaps plans your empty nights from recipes you saved; your household shares one plan and one grocery list, sorted by aisle. Then cook hands-free: say "next" or "start a 10-minute timer" with flour on your hands. iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo, in 21 languages, no ads.

records.name: Kegel Morse Hero
records.tagline: Kegel trainer for men that turns squeezes into Morse code
records.description: Guided pelvic floor workouts for men. Squeeze and relax to Morse code rhythms like SOS or your own word, with ring animation and haptics. Discreet and eyes-free. Studies link Kegels to better bladder control and erections. No account, no ads.

records.name: Koalab Web Catalog
records.tagline: A free web catalog that sends orders to your WhatsApp
records.description: Pick one of 99+ templates, add your products and share one link. Customers choose size, color and quantity, and the order reaches your WhatsApp with the total. Free up to 50 products, no card and no commission. Same stock as your WooCommerce or Mercado Libre.

records.name: Flipi
records.tagline: Profit tools and car tracking for UK car flippers
records.description: For UK car flippers: check a deal with a free profit calculator, MOT history check, auction fee calculators and an AI advert check, then track each car's costs, receipts and sale in one place. First car free.

records.name: WordsEvolve
records.tagline: Writing platform that keeps every edit visible to readers
records.description: WordsEvolve is a writing platform that keeps the history of a piece instead of hiding it. When you edit something after publishing, the changes aren't silently overwritten. They're stored and celebrated, so readers can follow how your writing evolved over time.

records.name: Omni Brain
records.tagline: Win back your focus with 5-minute brain games
records.description: Your attention gets pulled in a hundred directions a day. Omni Brain trains it back in five minutes: 80+ short games for memory, focus and logic. Every game teaches a real technique, explains each mistake and adapts to your level. iPhone and Android, works offline.

records.name: Well Drilling Guide
records.tagline: Find well drillers near you, and know what a well costs
records.description: Independent guide for U.S. and Canadian homeowners with private wells. See the closest listed well drillers on a map (no sign-up, no paid placement), check permit rules for 20 states and provinces, and plan costs before you ask for quotes.

records.name: Whistler Roam
records.tagline: Free local guide to what's open now in Whistler
records.description: A free, locally run guide to 830 places in Whistler, Squamish and Pemberton: a map of what's open near you right now, live happy hours, 190+ local events and a free trip planner that only uses places that are open. Built by a BC-raised former tour guide.

records.name: Bookworm
records.tagline: AI book summaries by goal, in 1, 5 or 10 minutes
records.description: Most book summaries give everyone the same generic recap. Bookworm summarises any book for what you actually need: life lessons, leadership takeaways, talking points for a meeting, or an action checklist. Pick 1, 5 or 10 minutes, or upload your own PDF and get a citation-linked summary. Built in India. Free to start.
